articles.summary: Dear Duchenne Community, We are pleased to share a meaningful update on the INSPIRE DUCHENNE clinical study, our multi-center, open-label clinical trial evaluating SGT-003, our investigational gene therapy for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
